risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI Agent Ethics, Fairness & Bias Detection, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to AI Output / Decision Integrity Failure (R-AI-1), AI Bias / Discriminatory Outcome (R-AI-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Session Audit
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to provide session audit capabilities that can: 
(1) Capture and log all content related to a user session; and
(2) Remotely view all content related to an established user session in real time.
compensating_control_1.justification: Session Audit (MON-18.1) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Ethics, Fairness & Bias Detection (AAT-39.22) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
